tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dpal mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud las 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs 'bring po rnal 'byor bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// dpal mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud las 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs 'bring po rnal 'byor bzhi pa zhes bya ba bla ma lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad pa zhes rnam pa'i 'khor lo 'od gsal dbyings su sdom mdzad shrī he ru ka'i don// srid gsum 'di ba'i tha snyad brda dang mtshan mar byed pa kha sbyor bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// dbu mar gnas pa'i snying rje'i gang bas 'gag pa med pa'i mchog gi 'phrin las dus gsum 'char ba gang*// ma lus pa yi bdag po chen po rdo rje sems dpar 'dud do de yis deng 'dir dge legs stsol// spros 'os ha cang min 'dod la// rdo rje btsun mos sbyin pa'i lung*// rnam nges byed pa bdag 'os ces// gsol ba'i ngor 'di bya ba spro// 'dir bcu gsum gyi lha'i 'khor lo sdom pa sgom par 'dod pa dag la/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum las/ dang po la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ dang po la srung 'khor/ tshogs bsags/ 'byung brtsegs/ padma sgom pa bzhi'i dang po ni/ rgyud nas mchog bsgrub par bsngags pa'i gnas su rnal 'byor gyi yo byad bsags pa 'am/ ku sā li pa zhig na yid kyis tshang bar bsam la/ de la dang por brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor ma// de sras tilli nā ro dang*/ lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mar mi la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ ras chung zhabs dang khyung tshang pa// ma gcig kong jo lo chen zhang*// dha ra shrī bsod nams mtshan// gsol ba= kun ldan ras ma bde legs pa// kun dga' dpal dang rgyal ba'i dbang*// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po la// gsol= ma bgrangs bcu gsum sa bgrod de// rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal tshab tu// mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan padma dkar// gsol ba= rgyal tshab dam pa lha rtse'i zhabs// snying rje'i dbang phyug dpag bsam dbang*// 'jam dbyangs buddha kun dga' rje// gsol ba=

mkhas mchog yar 'phel thugs rdo rje// bde chen zhabs dang 'jam pa'i dpal// kun gzigs chos kyi snang ba la// gsol ba= mtshungs med mkhas grub chos kyi rje// 'jam dpal ye shes grub pa dang*// nges don chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhabs// gsol ba= rdo rje slob dpon mtshungs med rje// 'jam dpal shes bya kun mkhyen dang*// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog /gsol ba= rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'brug ba rje/ 'jigs med mi pham chos kyi dbang*// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong yang*// gang gi rol rtsed yin shes nas// rje btsun bla ma khyed min pa'i// skyabs gzhan bdag cag rnams mi 'tshol// de phyir nyam nga'i 'khor ba nas// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i thugs rje'i mthu// bskul ba'i gsol ba 'debs lags na// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// smin byed dbang gis rgyud gsos nas// grol lam gser 'gyur rtsis sbran pa'i// mi gtsang lus 'di rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen mchog tu gyur cig gu/ dbang bzhi ni/ sgyu 'phrul zhing khams rgya mtsho sogs/ tshig gi dbu mar mdzad par byin gyis rlobs// yang na dbang bzhi zhu ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ mtshan rnams yongs rdzogs bla ma'i sku// spyi bor lus kyi thig le la// zhugs nas bum dbang dga' ba'i chus// sad pa'i sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// longs spyod rdzogs pa kun gyi skad// mgrin par ngag gi thig le la// zhugs nas gsang dbang mchog dga'i mes// rmi lam bag chags sreg tu gsol// dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi sku// snying khar yid kyi thig le la// zhugs nas shes rab ye shes nyis// gnyid stug mun pa bsal du gsol// mgon po lhan cig skyes pa'i sku// lte bar ye shes thig le la// zhugs nas bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas// 'pho med thob par byin gyis rlobs// drug pa zhu bstim smon lam ni/ de ltar bdag dang 'gro rnams kyi// lus ngag yid dang ye shes tshogs// rdo rje bzhi dang mnyam sbyor bas// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug thob par shog/

skyabs 'gro ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas brtsams te mgon med bdag /snying po byang chub ma thob par// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// bdag dang 'gro rnams skyabs pa'i phyir// rkang gnyis gtso bo'i sku gsum bdag /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi// tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs// phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ mgon po khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags// phyin chad sdig las ldog par bgyi// deng nas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi// khyed kyi bslab bya rjes su slob// khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar// kun nas yongs su bskyab tu gsol// lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbacom ldan 'das bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badzra satt+wa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satt+watwenopatiṣṭha/ dṛḍho me bhab/ sutoṣyo me bhab/ su poṣyo me bhab/ a nu rakto me bhab/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbhagaban sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa/ badzrī bhab/ mahā sa ma ya satt+wa āḥ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi 'od zer gyis khams gsum na gnas pa'i bdud bgegs gdon thams cad mdun du bkug pa la/

oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādyanutpannatwāt/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ gtor ma byin rlobs/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// lus srul la sogs gang ci yang*// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs// ci ste ngas bsgo su zhig 'da'// rdo rje bdag po sku yis ni// lus srul las skyes 'gas byas te// 'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// sa yi phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis dpal he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po sgrub cing mchod par byed pa la bar du gcod par brtsam pa gang su yang rung ba sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang klu dang lha ma yin dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ rjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang rgan mo dang g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig 'di ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhna gṛhna huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhna pa ya gṛhnā pa ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wan badzra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhal bzhi nas kha gdong ma la sogs pa bzhi/ thugs ka nas gshin rje'i brtan ma la sogs pa bzhi/ lte ba yan khro mo/ man rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs su gnas pa'i phur bu'i rnam par phyung ste/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni sarba bighnan a nutstshed ye kī la ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ rang gi sems las gyur pa'i phyogs mtshams kyi bgegs kyi gtso bo rnams kyi snying gar btab nas bzhugs pa'i 'od kyis bgegs kyi tshogs lhag ma thams cad bsreg par gyur/

de nas chos thams cad la dmigs pa rab tu mi gnas par gyur ba'i stong pa nyid la cung zad bzhag go /stong pa de las oṃ me de ni badzrī bha wa badzra bhandha hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra prā ka ra hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i rwa ba/ oṃ badzra pañdzā ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i gur/ oṃ badzra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i bla re/ oṃ badzra sa ra dzwa la trāṃ saṃ trāṃ/ rdo rje mda'i dra ba/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na lārkaka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phyi rol du me ri rnam pa lnga rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ de nas lag mchod bkod nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du padma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba la oṃ baṃ dmar po/ 'dab ma la g.yon skor gyi haṃ yauṃ sngon mo/ hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ dud kha/ dpa' mo drug gi rang bzhin mthe bong la/ oṃ haḥdakar po/ mdzub mo la na ma hi ser po/ gung mo la swā hā hu dmar po/ srin lag la bauṣṭa he nag po/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥmathing kha/ sen mo'i ngos la phaṭ haṃ ljang khu/ dpa' bo drug gi rang bzhin/ lag pa'i bol la 'di dag nyid kyi gzugs brnyan/ lag pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams rim pa bzhin ltung byed/ gsod byed/ 'gugs byed/ gar gyi dbang phyug padma dra ba can ma rnams kyi rang bzhin no// de nas chang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul zhing ster mchod/ bza' btung thams cad rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis 'bul ba ni/ oṃ na mo bhag ba te bī re shā ya/ mahā kalpāgni sannibhāya/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭotkaṭāya/ daṃṣṭā ka rā lo gra bhīṣa ṇa mu khā ya// sa ha sra bhudza bhāsu rā ya/ par shu pā shodyata shū la khaṭwāṃg dhāri ni/ byāghrā dzi nāmbar dharā ya/ mahā dhūmrāndhakār wa pu ṣā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badzra wā rā hi baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ārya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kyā rā ma te ma hā bi dye shwa ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ sarba bhu ta bha ya ba he ma hā badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shaṃ ka ri ne tra bhrā ma ṇī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ be ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā ni li nī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tra sa ni ma ra ni su pra bhe da ni pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ye bi dzaṃ ye dzaṃ bha ni staṃ bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī ka me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ma tshang ba kha bskang ba'i don du/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ shrī he ru ka twe no pa tiṣṭha sogs brjod/ de nas lag mthil du yod pa'i khu ba srin lag gis blangs nas snying lce mgo bo rnams su hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ brjod pas byug cing*/ ngo bo lha rnam pa yi ger bzhugs pa de bdag nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum la thim par gyur/ lhag ma bdud rtsi'i nang du blug cing bsnyen pa bzhin du byin gyis brlab bo// mdun du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du ā las padma'i snod dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba thod pa gsum gyi sgyed pu la gnas pa'i nang du oṃ āṃ trāṃ khāṃ hūm̐/ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron me lnga rlung gis bskul bas me 'bar thod pa bsros pas rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char kha'i kha dog can de'i steng du dngul chu'i mdog can gyi hūm̐ las byung ba'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po thur du blta ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bas ro gcig par gyur pa rnams a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ ā li g.yon skor/ kā li g.yas skor du song ba yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge brtsegs mar gnas pa de dag las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams 'phros/

'gro ba'i don byas snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba'i 'od du zhu nas yi ge gsum la rim pa bzhin thim/ oṃ yig tu zhu bas sbyangs/ āḥyig gis mang por spel/ hūm̐ yig gis sbar ba dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs so// de nas bdud rtsi de srin lag gis dkyil 'khor la 'thor zhing*/ pu dzā oṃ ā go ra de mā kā oṃ trī ko kā laṃ kā hi pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/ yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi de yongs su gyur pa las pu li ra ma dang dzā lan dha ra dang*/ o ḍi yā na dang*/ arpu ta bzhi gnas te sa rab tu dga' ba/ go dā wa ri dang*/ ra me shār dang*/ de wi ko ṭa mā la wa bzhi nye ba'i gnas sa dri ma med pa kā ma ru dang o tra gnyis zhing sa 'od byed pa/ tri sha ku ne dang*/ ko sa la gnyis nye zhing*/ sa 'od 'phro ba/ ka lidga dang*/ lam pa ka gnyis tshandho/ sa sbyang dka' ba/ kāñtsi dang hi ma la gnyis/ nye ba'i tshandho/ sa mngon du gyur pa pre ta pu ri dang*/ gri ha de wa gnyis 'du ba/ sa ring du song ba/ sau raṣṭa dang*/ su warṇa dī pa gnyis nye ba'i 'du ba/ sa mi g.yo ba/ na ga ra dang*/ sindhu gnyis dur khrod/ sa legs pa'i blo gros/ ma ru dang ku lu ta gnyis nye ba'i dur khrod sa chos kyi sprin/

zhes brjod cing*/ yul de dag tu gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas par gyur/ sprul sku'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas dzambu gling gi yul ji lta bar snang ba de sbyang ba'i phyir/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs ras bris/ tshom bu'am ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ paṃ hūm̐ paṃ brtsegs pa rim pa bzhin zhu ba las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gaṃ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du ri rab dang*/ sna tshogs padma lhun po'i kha khyab pa'i dkyil du sna tshogs rdo rje rwa bcu gnyis pa/ de'i lte bar padma'i sdong po gyen du 'phags pa 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ ge sar dmar ser/ lte ba mthing kha gri gug gi 'phreng bas mu khyud byas pa/ rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ yig 'thon de'i lte bar 'khod/ de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba padma nang ma'i phyi la rang bzhin gyis rnam par snang mdzad rnams yongs su gyur pa'i rin po che'i gzhal yas khang dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i brtsigs pa dwangs shing gsal la sgrib pa med pa kha dog bkra ba 'od zer gyi phung por 'bar ba gru bzhi pa/ rgya khyon mnyam pa rmang gi phyir 'dod pa'i snam bu dmar po/ kha khyer la rin po che'i snam bu ser po/ rtsig steng du mun pa'i snam bu dra ba dang dra phyed dar dpyangs kyis spras pa/ bya 'dab kyi sna la thur du shar bu rtsig pa'i steng thad du mda' yab dkar po padma phyed pa'i dbyibs can/ khang pa brtsegs ma steng ma'i dbus 'phyur bu rdo rje rin po che'i tog logs bzhir sgo bzhi twa ra nas mdzes pa de'i steng du padma la gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong gdugs dang bcas pa la g.yas g.yon nas ri dwags ru ru zung mig mi 'dzum par blta ba rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa/

ri rab kyi phyir dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong*/ zhing skyong*/ klu/ rnal 'byor pa/ shing*/ me/ chu/ sprin/ ri brgyad brgyad ro dang lce spyang sha za dang srin po za byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis gang zhing 'jigs su rung bas yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus kyi padma'i lte ba nyi gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdub bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngams pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/

an tras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// shar sgor khā gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi'i steng ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ lha de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐/ gtso bo'i snying gar oṃ haḥdapral bar na ma hi/ spyi bor swā hā hu/ phrag pa gnyis su bau ṣa ṭa he/ spyan gsum la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥyan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃ/ gtso mo'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ snying gar yaṃ yauṃ/ mgrin par hrīṃ moṃ/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/

ces go cha'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor zhing cang te'u la sogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra drag tu 'khrol bas/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ oṃ gu ru badzra shrī he ru ka ā kaḍḍhaya/ ā kaḍḍha ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki nī hri da ya/ a pa to ṣa ya/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba wī ra yo gi nī swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes sogs kyi spyan drangs pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod cing de bas ting nge 'dzin/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'og min gyi zhing nas bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ye shes kyi 'khor lo chen po mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ sta gon gyi dus bteg pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de la khrus ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ mgon po 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ añtsa mā naṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pādyaṃ/ oṃ a badzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin nyer mchod lhag ma rol mo dang bcas pa 'bul/ bza' btung*/ lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ rig ma/ mdzes ma 'di dag phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rigs lnga las byung 'di phul bas// rigs pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin shog /lha dang mi yi bde ba ni// bsdus byas rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// bcu drug char yang mi phod pa'i// dga' ba bla na med pas mchod// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ

zhes pa nas/ oṃ badzra bā ra hi ma hā yo gi nī ka me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gong bzhin rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod do// lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas dzaḥye shes pa rnams dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i steng du bkug hūm̐ de dag la bzhug baṃ gnyis med du bcings/ ho ro gcig tu gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo'i rgyal po yab yum rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la dbang bskur/ lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa yum la rnam snang*/ phyogs ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ sgo ma bzhi la snang mtha'/ mtshams ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rnal 'byor bdud rtsi ro gcig gsol ba'i thugs ni rnam par dag pa ste// gnas la sogs pa'i yul du bgrod pa'i sku ni rnam par dag pa yi// dpal ldan gnas kyi dbus kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo mchog gi mgon po ni// bla ma mchog la rtag tu mgo bos btud de gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpa' bo kun gyi sku ni rtag tu mdzes pa ste// lha mo rnams kyi rin chen sku yis 'khyud pas brgyan// 'khor lo gnas mgon lhan cig skyes dga' dri med pa'i// rnal 'byor snying po bde mchog la yang rtag phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas kun mkhyen shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas// lha mo rnams ni lhan cig skyes pa'i gnas kyi mdzes// 'dren pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba 'byung ba ste/dri med lhan cig skyes pa mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/

zhes phyag 'tshal/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ prokṣa nan pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ las thams cad pa'i chus 'thor 'thung*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐/ mchod yon/ oṃ āḥ.añtsa ma naṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐/ pādyaṃ/ zhabs bsil dang*/ de nas gtso bo nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar la/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la samba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrī ha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nyer mchod lnga 'bul ba/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes btags la 'bul/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni ye badzra warṇa ni ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ puṣpe/ sogs gong bzhin/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ru pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gong bzhin nyer mchod lnga/ oṃ kā kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lu kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa nā ka sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka rā sya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gong bzhin nyer mchod/ oṃ ya ma dā dhi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ puṣpe/ sogs gong bzhin nyer mchod lnga btags pa la phyogs g.yon bskor/ mtshams g.yas bskor gyis phul/ dzambu gser las rang byung lte ba zlum// rtsibs stong mu khyud mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba// mkha' la rab 'phags phyogs las rgyal byed pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ tsakra ratna pra tītstsha swā hā/ thal kar mche ba drug pa zla 'od can// chu zheng phun tshogs yid kyis mkha' lam nas// sa chen rgya mtsho'i ska rags can bskor ba'i// glang po rin chen= hasti ratna= spu kha rma bya'i mgrin 'dra yid 'ong zhing*// gser gyi rgyan ldan mgyogs pa yid lta bus// tho rangs sa rnams bskor te slar ldog pa'i// rta mchog rin chen=

a shwa ratna= kun tu sngo ba snang byed bai ḍūrya// nyin mor byed pa 'od kyis rnam gnon cing*// bsam pa rdzogs byed legs sbyangs cha brgyad pa// nor bu rin chen= ma ni ratna= 'chi med bu mo bzhin du gzugs mdzes shing*// reg bya mchog gis lus sems bde byed pa// sgyu rtsal kun shes smra mkhas dri bzang ster// btsun mo rin chen= st+rī ratna= phur bu'i blo ldan mdzangs shing yid gzhung pa/ khor yug gter gyi 'dod dgur 'dzud byed cing*// nges pa snyan pa'i tshig 'byin lha mig can// khyim bdag rin chen= pu ru ṣa ratna= sred med bu yi stobs ldan dpa' ba dang*// rtul phod yid la rgyas pa'i don rnams kun// mod la sgrub cing phas rgol med byed pa// blon po rin chen= khaḍga ratna= 'od zer gyis sngo ral gri lpags pa 'jam// dga' ba'i nags tshal gos ni yid rjes 'gro// mthu ldan mchil lham khang khyim gzhal du med// reg 'jam gzim cha= u pa ratna= phyi mchod do// mthon mthing 'od chags rdo rje pi waṃ ma// rgyud mangs snyan pa'i skad kyis yid bsgyur byed// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje'i yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ āḥbadzra wi ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ// mchog gi gser mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// snyan 'gyur rin chen gling bu'i sgra dbyangs can// rdo rje= he ru ka= waṃ she hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bim pa ltar dmar rdo rje rdza rnga ma// skad snyan lha rdzas bzang po'i rdza rnga 'khrol// rdo rje= he ru= mu rañdze= margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga chen ma// rnga chen cher sgrog nam mkha'i phyogs kun 'gengs// rdo rje= he ru= mṛ taṃ ge= padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan bzhad pa mo// 'dzum zhal dgyes pa'i bzhin gyis kun dga' bskyed// rdo rje= he ru= hā sye= mthon ka chen mo'i 'od 'dzin rab sgeg mo// rdo rje dril 'chang dkur brten snyems pa'i tshul// rdo rje=

he ru= lā sye= btso ma'i gser mdog rdo rje glu dbyangs ma// shes rab dbyangs snyan rna ba'i bcud len mkhan// rdo rje= he ru= gī tī= rma bya'i spu ltar sngo ljang gar mkhan ma// mnyen lcug yan lag mchog gi bro gar bsgyur// rdo rje= he ru= nri tye= ston zla ltar dkar rdo rje me tog ma// lha rdzas me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs byed// rdo rje= he ru= puṣpe= sngo skya dud sprin rdo rje bdug spos ma// mkha' khyab dri zhim bdug pa'i spos sprin can// rdo rje= he ru= dhū pe= gur gum gzhon nu'i lus can snang gsal ma// rin chen snang bas phyogs bcu'i mun sel byed// rdo rje= he ru= dī paṃ= 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar skyas byug pa ma// legs sbyar dri mchog dge bas rnyog pa sel// rdo rje= he ru= gandhe= kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar gzugs brnyan ma// rnam dag rin chen dngul dkar me long g.yob// rdo rje= he ru= rū pa= leb rgan rtsi ltar lus dmar ro ldan ma// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas 'dzin// rdo rje= he ru= rā sye= dur ba'i 'dab ltar ljang ser reg bya ma// reg pa'i bde ba mchog ster na bza' 'dzin// rdo rje= he ru= sparshe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ kunda ku muta rgyas 'dra chos dbyings ma// rgyal ba kun bskyed skye gnas phyag rgya can// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje'i yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ āḥbadzra dharma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

nang mchod do// mchod do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rtsa rgyud kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la sambha raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrī ha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni ye badzra warṇa ni ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra be ro tsa ni ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a= oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ= oṃ kā kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u llu kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa na kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka ra sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ= oṃ ya ma da dhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣṭi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du pañtsa a mṛ pū dza khā hi/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i= dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen mo bya rog ming can 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i=

gzhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa la sogs lha ma srin sde brgyad 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pu dza khā hi/ gsang mchod do// las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang*// ye shes phyag rgya'i dmigs pa dang*// phyag rgya chen po gcig sbyor bas// 'phel ba'i mi 'gyur bde bas mchod// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces pa sngon du btang nas/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi brgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul rngams pa'i zhal// sku yi phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen bgegs mthar bskrad la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigasapa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bum bskyed ni/ rin po che'am rdza'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dgu

las bum dang bcas/ med na gnyis gtsang mar bkrus/ spos kyis bdug mgul ras bzang pos dkris/ lha'i mtshan ma bkod/ gdan ku sha 'am med na ras bzang po'i khar bzhag rnam rgyal gyi khar rnam rgyal chen po'i thod pa'am/ med na dung chos/ de'i khar rdo rje gzungs thag btags pa bzhag thams cad kyi kha rgyan bkra shis pa'i shing lo'am ku sha nang du lnga tshan nyer lnga btab pa'i rgyun bcas kyi chus gsum gnyis bkang*/ de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bum pa bzang po'i nang du pad nyi la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdub bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngams pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/

lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ an tras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi 'dab ba ma la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub dang las bum du dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// shar sgor khā gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi'i steng ro yi gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga bcu do shal can/ sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ lha de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐/

gtso bo'i snying gar oṃ haḥdapral bar na ma hi/ spyi bor swā hā hu/ phrag pa gnyis su bauṣa ṭa he/ spyan gsum la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥyan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃ/ gtso mo'i lte bar oṃ baṃ/ snying gar yaṃ yauṃ/ mgrin par hrīṃ moṃ/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang lha rig lnga dang bcas pa pheṃ/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mig g.yon pa'i steng gi dpral ba'i thad kar bskor mig gyen du ldog pa rkang pa g.yas brkyang g.yon pas bol gong mnan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gyis bum bskyed kyi lha la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khrag 'thung chen po rigs lngas bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i ka pā las spyi bo nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus ngag yid ye shes kyi dri ma dag bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ sku bzhi'i he ru ka rdzogs pa nyid kyi spyi bor mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ phyogs ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ sgo ma bzhi la snang mtha'/ mtshams ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes rgyas btab par bya/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar// lha yi dri yis nye bar byugs// me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la// gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol// oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ tsandan gur gum sbyar ba yi// dri mchog bdug spos dam pa 'di// dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la bzhes su gsol// dhū pe= mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba 'di// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed cing*// lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di// bdag la dgongs te bzhes su gsol// dī paṃ= sna tshogs lha yi dri dang ldan// sna tshogs ga bur gyis ni brgyan// sna tshogs hūṃ las yang dag byung*// dri mchog 'di dag=

gandhe= kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*// zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du= nai wī dya= zhing 'di rgyal srid sna bdun gyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i phyir// nyin bzhin shes rab can gyis mchod// oṃ āḥratna sapta huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ phyi mchod do// bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'phrul// pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can// brgyad gnyis lang tsho dpal 'bras nu 'bur ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma// nya rgyas zla ba dag pa'i bzhin ras ma// tshem zhing gsal ba bdud rtsi'i 'od ldan ma// rdo rje'i rig ma lha mos deng mchod nas// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod// oṃ āḥbadzra wi ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin/ waṃ she= mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ ge= bde mchog sgyu ma'i= rgod dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs rol gar mkhan// zur mig 'phen mkhas 'dod pa'i mda' 'phen ma// 'chi med na chung sgyu ma'i 'jo sgeg ma// yid 'phrog dpa' mo rdo rje'i glu dbyangs ma// 'gying gzugs glog 'dra gar dgu'i rtsed 'jo ma// rdo rje rig ma= mchog tu= hā sye= lā sye= gī tī= nṛtye= bde mchog= me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog 'dzin// rnam rgyas pad dkar gzhon nu'i zhal mdzes ma// dri zhim mar me gsar pa'i dri ldan ma// mtshar sdug 'od kyis phyogs cha rnam 'gengs ma// ga bur tsandan shing ltar gdung sel ma// rdo rje= mchog tu= puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gandhe= bde mchog= gzugs bcud reg bya chos kyi lha mo ni// mdzes sdug dpe byad bzang po'i dpal ldan ma// ma mchu bdud rtsi gtsang ma'i ro ldan ma// reg byas dbang po kun nas tshim byed ma// bsam yas lhan cig skyes dga'i 'byung gnas ma// rdo rje= mchog= rū pa= ra sya= sparshe= oṃ āḥbadzra dharma dhā tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

nang mchod byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la saṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni badzra warṇa ni ye= oṃ badzra bai ro tsa ni ye= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ḍā ki= oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he= oṃ ru pi ṇi ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ kā kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u llu= oṃ shwa na kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka rā sye= oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ya ma= oṃ ya ma dū tī ye= oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsang mchod do// de nas mnyam par bzhag ste/ rang rdzas mdzes pa nyid kyi rdzas// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa chen po'i rgyu de yis// thams cad stong pa mngon sum du// byas la bde ched skad cig gis// rdzogs par byas la mchod par bya// de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi brgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul rngams pa'i zhal// sku yi phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra sta zhags pa kha ṭwāṃ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen bgegs mthar bskrad la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmugs byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod//

zhes tshig sbrel gyi rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni= de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas gtso bo yab yum las bum la brgya rtsa brgyad/ lha gzhan la nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ de dus/ sngags 'phreng bdag gi kha nas 'thon gzungs thag la 'khril/ rnam rgyal chen po dang bum pa'i nang du song bas lha rnams chags pa bdo nas/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams dang lha mo rnams kyi bha ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun chi li li babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzwa la saṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā kī nī ye badzra warṇa ni ye= oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye= oṃ lā me= oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi= oṃ rū pi nī ye= oṃ ka kā sye= oṃ ullu kā sye= oṃ shwa na ka sye= oṃ sū ka rā sye= oṃ ya ma da dhī= oṃ ya ma dū ti ye= oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭi nī ye= oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

sogs bzlas pa'i mthar/ rnam rgyal chen po'i lha rnams bdud rtsi zhu bas bum nang gi lha la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang gnyis med du gyur par bsam mo/ rnam rgyal chen po'i chu de dag tu cung zad re blug par bya'o// de nas/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bzlas/ de nas phyi gtor ni/ phyi rol du song nas shar du/ ind+ra sa pa ri wā ra ṇa ā karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bkug oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ ind+ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum la sogs pas phul/ saṃ tripta sarba de wa tā sā dha kā sye shantiṃ ku ru sarba kadyantu siddhi rba ti ya thā su khaṃ su khe/ mer/ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra ṇa a karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ= agna ye sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum/ saṃ tripta sarba de wa tā sa dhā kā sye shintaṃ ku ru sarba kadyantu siddhi rba ti ya thā su khaṃ su khe/ lhor/ yam sa pa ri= oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum/ saṃ tripta sogs puṣṭiṃ ku ru sogs gzhan la rigs 'gre lho nub tu/ rakṣa sa pa ri wā ra ṇa sogs sa dha ka sye puṣṭiṃ sogs gong bzhin nub tu/ wa ru nā= a karṣa ya sogs sā dha kā sye wa shaṃ ku ru= nub byang du/ bā yu sa pa ri wā ra= sa dha ka sye wa shaṃ ku ru= byang du/ ku bai rā sa pa ri wā ra= mā ra ya sarba kadyantu= dbang ldan du/ mahā bhu ta sa nas mā ra ya steng du tsand+ra surya brahma ārya de ba ta sa pa ri= shintaṃ ku ru sarba= 'og tu/ be tse tri pri thi wī de wa ta sa pa ri wā ra= sā dha ka sye shintaṃ ku ru sarba katyantu siddhi rba ti ya thā su khaṃ su khe/ de nas 'dod gsol/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srung*// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod// nang du phebs nas cad te'u 'khrol zhing*/ sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyis ni 'gro ba'i yid kyi 'dod pa mchog ni kun rdzogs mdzad// he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer thams cad phye mar brlags// gang zhig 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhing bla ma rgyal ba'i ye shes 'byung gnas mthar phyin mdzad// de ni snying rje chen po'i dbang gyur 'phags pa rnams kyi rtag tu myur bar bkra shis yin// zhes pa'i glu len zhing dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi de la lan gsum du bskor/ longs sku'i rnal 'byor ro// bcu pa ni dbang bskur ba la sngon du dkyil 'khor gyi sgo phye ste/ phyi dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad pa'i phyir slob ma rnams bos/ khrus byas/ oṃ badzra argha ṭa ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo phye ste/ ji ltar bltams pa= oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// lus srul la sogs gang ci yang*// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs// ci ste ngas bsgo su zhig 'da'// rdo rje bdag po sku yis ni// lus srul las skyes 'gas byas te// 'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// sa yi phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis dpal he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal por 'jug cing dbang zhu ba la/ bar du gcod par byed pa gang su yang sogs bgegs bskrad/ thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa zhes pa nas me ri rnam pa lnga rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen por 'jug pa zhu ba'i yon du oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐

sogs manḍal phul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings/ a khaṃ bi ra hūm̐ gis cod pan gtad thal mo sbyar ba sngon du 'gro bas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// slob ma zhes pa don dam smra ba'i seng ge yis// nyon mongs srid pa'i nyes pa skye ba'i sa gzhom phyir// rnal 'byor cho gas nyon mongs g.yos pa gcod pa yi// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid 'grub par mdzod// ces dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir gsol ba gdab bo// kye khyed su zhig ces dri bdag ni skal bzang ngo*// zhes lan gdab/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang sems kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da yā mi/ lan gsum/ su ra te sa ma yast+waṃ hoḥsiddhi badzra ya tha su khaṃ zhes rdo rje snying gar gtugs pas byin gyis brlab a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis dngos su yol ba'i nang du khrid skad cig gis de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bskyed/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma rnam par snang mdzad du gsal bar gyur/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag nyid rab tu gzhug par bgyi/ zhes lha la gsol btab gnang ba thob nas shar sgor bcug lha rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dzo pasṭhā nā ya/ ātma naṃ nirya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta ḍā ki nī adhi tiṣṭha swa māṃ/ mkha' 'gro mas rdo rje gcig gnang ba snying gar thim/ de nas byang gi sgo ru phyin/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya/

ātma naṃ niryā ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta lā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ lā mas rdo rje rgya gram gcig sbyin pa dpral bar thim/ nub sgor oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza pra warta nā ya/ ātma naṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta khaṇḍa ro hi niryā pra warta ya māṃ/ khaṇḍa ro his padma gcig sbyin pa mgrin bar thim/ de nas lho sgor song ste/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dzo karma ṇe/ ātma naṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pi ni ātma karmā ku ru māṃ/ gzugs can mas rin po che gcig sbyin pa spyi bor thim/ slar shar khyams su bzhag slob ma 'jug yon dang bcas te/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mchog /stsal nas mgon pos bdag la ni// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang*// sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig ni// sdom pa gsang ba bla na med// rtag tu sems can kun don phyir// slob dpon du 'gyur bdag la gsungs// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ dkyil 'khor ba la che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng bdag 'dir// byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin zhing*// gsang ba'i don gyi 'khor lo 'dir// dam tshig sdom la 'jug par 'tshal// zhes gsol/ de nas slob mar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i// gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni// bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam// zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang*/ bdag ni rab tu de 'tshal lo// zhes khas blangs/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen gyis ni bzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bya// 'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya// de las gzhan pa bcu bzhi ni// phas pham par ni rab tu bshad// spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste// rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do//

zhes dam tshig sgrag thun mong gi sdom pa blang ba slob mas/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu nges mdzad pa'i// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te mchog tu bzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa blang ba/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma ni snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag dus 'di nas bzung nas// ji srid gnyis med la gnas pa// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med par// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par gsungs//

lan gsum/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyi/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya bas/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu bral te gshegs// mna' chu blud pa bdud rtsi'i ril bu chang dang sbyar ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pañtsa amṛ to da ka hūm̐/ de nas slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru nga yin gyis/ ngas gang byos shig bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba btab pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ dngos po dang mtshan ma gang la'ang ma zhen par bla ma dang yi dam la mos pa rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas rang gi spyi bor bla ma dpal he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems babs/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad mer gyis khengs par gyur/ byi la'i brun dang bud med bzang mo'i zla mtshan gyis sbags pa'i ras bdud rtsi lnga ste/ bdun bsres pa'i spos bdug

rol mo'i sgra drag pos/ oṃ tiṣṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bidya ma hā bidya rā dza dhīḥm he swā hā/ zhes bzlas phebs na/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyi rnam par bzhag ste brtan par bya'o// de nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog ci mthong*// zhes dri/ sna tshogs su mthong ngo*// dkar po sogs/ 'phrin las bzhi 'grub pa yin no// brda sprad lho phyogs su gnas pas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag nyid rab tu gzhug par bya// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di yi bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog/ ces slob dpon gyis bden pa'i stobs brjod slob mas bum pa'i mtshan ma'i lha grangs kyi tshom bu logs su byas pa skad cig gi lhar dmigs pa la/ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes pas dor/ lha de'i mtshan ma dang de dang nye bar babs na'ang de'i rigs su shes par bya'o// lha des slar me tog gi 'phreng ba dngos grub kyi don du mgo bor bcings par gyur/ pra ti grihna st+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra ni tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes brjod pas gdong g.yog bsal/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub kun khyod mngon du 'gyur// rnam dag ni/ ri mo nyi shu phyogs bzhi pa// de ni dpa' bo'i rnam pa'o// 'khor lo'i rtsibs ni rnal 'byor ma// lte ba rdo rje phag mo ste// sa bon zhes grags khrag 'thung mchog

/'dab ma mkha' 'gro ma'i rang bzhin// dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog /sum cu rtsa bdun rnam dag pa'o// des na he ru ka dpal rgyud// sems rgyud dri med yin par bshad// dag pa'i chos kyi sprul ba ni// phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin// thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las// de nyid dang ni thams cad byung*// me long la sogs rnam par bzhi// padma'i 'dab gnas rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro ma sogs padmar gnas// mā ma ki sogs bzang mo yin// khro bo rnam rgyal la sogs kun// sgo dang mtha' yi mtshams rnams su// sna tshogs 'dul ba'i thabs can gyis// sems can don la brtson par mdzad//

ces bshad do// dbang bskur ba la bzhi ste/ bum dbang gsang ba shes rab ye shes bzhi pa'o// dang po la slob ma'i dbang lnga slob dpon gyi dbang la drug ste bcu gcig gong ma gsum bsnan bas dbang bskur bcu gcig gsungs so// dang po dbang lnga'i don du maṇḍal/ rig pa'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags ri bcas// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkang ste// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun 'bul na// thugs rje chen pos dgongs nas bzhes te bskyab tu gsol// gu ru ratna maṇḍal kaṃ nirya ta ya mi// he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas bstsal// de bzhin bdag la de stsol zhig/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ dbang rdzas kyi bum chu dang bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa'i yum mā ma ki gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das mas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang bas dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis bkra shis kyi glu len zhing gur gum la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ sgo mtshams kyi khro mo rnams kyis bgegs kyi tshogs ring du skrod par gyur/

bum pa gzhan gyi chu rnam rgyal du bsdus/ des dngos su dbang bskur zhing*/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas rnam par shes pa'i phung po mi bskyod pa/ chu mā ma ki zhe sdang me long lta bu'i ye shes su rnam par dag pa yin no// zhes dbang don bshad/ de bzhin du cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa dang slob ma thig tu bshad pa bzhin rin 'byung yab yum du bskyed/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ dbang rdzas kyi cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa bdag nyid mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i dang las trāṃ las rin po che trāṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rin po che dang rin po che'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum dbyings phyug ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoṃḥdam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba'i cod pan du gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das mas rin po che'i cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis bkra shis kyi glu len zhing gur gum la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs sgo mtshams kyi khro mo rnams kyis bgegs kyi tshogs ring du skrod par gyur/

ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ zhes yum gyi snying po/ oṃ sarba bhuddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes cod pan gyis dbang bskur bas/ tshor ba'i phung po rin chen 'byung ldan nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su rnam par dag pa yin no// de bzhin rdo rje dang slob ma snang mtha' yab yum du bskyed/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi= oṃ swa bhā wa= dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje dang bdag nyid mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas padma hrīḥyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pa las snang ba mtha' yas dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa padma dang padma'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ snang ba mtha' yas zhu ba'i rdo rje gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das mas rdo rjes dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis bkra shis kyi glu len zhing gur gum la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ sgo mtshams kyi khro mo rnams kyis bgegs kyi tshogs ring du skrod par gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// de ring khyod la dbang bskur gyis// rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje bzung*// 'od dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas 'du shes kyi phung po 'od dpag med/

me gos dkar mo 'dod chags so sorartogs pa'i ye shes su rnam par dag pa yin no// dril bu dang slob ma don grub yab yum du bskyed/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi= oṃ swa bhā wa= dbang rdzas kyi dril bu dang bdag nyid mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las ral gri ās mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las don yod grub pa ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ral gri dang ral gri'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ don yod grub pa zhu ba'i dril bur gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das mas dril bus dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis bkra shis kyi glu len zhing gur gum la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs sgo mtshams kyi khro mo rnams kyis bgegs kyi tshogs ring du skrod par gyur/ oṃ badzra sa twa a dhi pa ti st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma yast+waṃ/ don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ 'du byed kyi phung po don yod grub pa/ rlung dam tshig sgrol ma/ phrag dog bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su rnam par dag pa yin no// slob ma rnam snang yab yum du bskyed/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi= oṃ swa bhā wa= bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum sangs rgyas spyan ma gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ sgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das mas rdo rje dang dril bu spyi bor 'dzin pa'i ming gi dbang bskur mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis bkra shis kyi glu len zhing gur gum la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ sgo mtshams kyi khro mo rnams kyis bgegs kyi tshogs ring du bskrad par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka a ddhi pa ti st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi shrī he ru ka na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ me tog phog pa'i rigs de'i ming thugs kyi rdo rje sogs gdags/ kye dpal rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ming gi dbang bskur bas/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ sa sangs rgyas spyan ma/ gti mug chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su rnam par dag pa yin no// de rnams kyis ma rig pa lnga las bzlog nas rig pa'i ye shes lnga bskyed pas rig pa'i dbang thob pa zhes bya'o// dbang 'di'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud nyan pa dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad 'chad pa la dbang ba yin no// drug pa phyir mi ldog pa'i phyir/ phyir mi ldog pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog /gu ru i daṃ=

ta yā mi/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon 'gyur/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phub par gyur/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu /rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang rin po che'i sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdub bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa int+ras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon yab la 'khyud pa/

g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdig mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal can gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ bcom ldan 'das mas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis bkra shis kyi glu len zhing gur gum la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ sgo mtshams kyi khro mo rnams kyis bgegs kyi tshogs ring du skrod par gyur/ de nas chu dbang ni/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ chu rgyun spyi bor 'khyil ba las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes rdo rje lag g.yas par gtad thugs kyi dam tshig go/ ā las skyes pa'i dril bu/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bar bzhed// dril bu g.yon du sbyin/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur//

zhes pas dkrol gsung gi dam tshig 'khyud stangs byas/ rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud// g.yon snyems pa dang sgrol 'don 'chang*// gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis rlobs// yid kyi lus ni bstan pa'i phyir// phyag rgya dam tshig ces brjod do// gang gi lus kun bstan byed pa// de'i ni phyag rgya rab tu grags// sku'i dam tshig rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid ye shes kyi rdo rjes dbang bskur bas/ ye shes kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa'/ ro chen po'i khams chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rnam par shes pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i dag pa yin no// sngags dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'thon rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs te snying gar nyi ma'i steng gi hūm̐ sngon po'i mthar hraṃ me 'khor bar gyur/ 'phreng ba gtad/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la sambha raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ ham̐'u phaṭ/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki ni ye badzra warṇā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kā kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lū ka sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa nā kā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka rā sye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma da dhī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū tī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣṭī ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma thā ṇi ye hu hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bhag ba te bī re shā ya/ mahā kalpāgni sanni bhā ya/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭotka ṭā ya/ daṃṣṭā ka rā lo gra bhīṣa ṇa mu khā ya// sa ha sra bhudza bhā su rā ya/
par shu pā shodyata shū la kha ṭwāṃ ga dhā ri ni/ byāghā dzi nāmbar dha rā ya/ mahā dhūmrāndha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya/

rkang pa nyer bzhi pa/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ bandha bandha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ kṣobhaya kṣobhaya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭ/ phaṭ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhakṣa bhakṣa/ pas rudhirānt+ra mā lā ba lambine/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ sapta pā tā la bhudzaṃgāṃ sarpaṃ wā/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaḍḍha ā kaḍḍha/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ/ oṃ haḥn ma hi/ swa ha hu/ bo ṣa ṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥphaṭ haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yauṃ/ hriṃ mauṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ lan gsum bzlas/ rdo rje dang me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bkod de/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum bya/ mthar rten bzhi ste/ brtul zhugs/ rjes gnang*/ lung bstan/ gzengs bstod/ de las brtul zhugs la/ rdo rje/ spyod pa/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs gsum las dang po/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' de zhu ba'i rdo rje/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bstan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dhā ra yā mi hi hi hi hi swā hā/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du gsal ba la ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bstim/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis rkun po'i skra las byas pa'i cod pan mgor tshangs skud stod du/ do shal rdo rje'i rgyan/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te nas dhi li dhi li bar lan gsum/ yum gyi nye snying thod pa lnga la/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lnga/ yi ge bdun pa'i rna rgyan la/ oṃ hrī ha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

lan gnyis rdo rje phag mo'i snying po'i sngags kyis mgul rgyan dang lpags pa'i gos gnyis/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ phaṭ gsum gtso bo'i snying pos mi mgo'i do shal/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ ḍā ki nī dzwa la saṃ wa raṃ swā hā/ lan gcig dpa' bo'i go chas gdub bu gnyis/ oṃ haḥn ma hi swa ha hu bau ṣa ṭa he huṃ hūm̐ hoḥphaṭ haṃ/ lan gnyis dpa' mo'i go chas ske rags la/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yauṃ/ hrīṃ mauṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ tshar gcig lha gzhan rnams kyi snying pos lag par thod pa/ oṃ ḍā ki ni nas ya ma mā tha ni ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ tshar gcig brjod/ rtsa sngags kyis kha ṭwāṃ/ cang te'u gtad pas so// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te nas dhi li dhi li huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan gsum rig ma'i brtul zhugs ni/ shes rab kyi lag pa slob ma'i lag par sbyin/ de gnyis rang gi lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas/ 'di ni khyed rnams dpang po yin// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// zhes/ sangs rgyas thams cad dpang por byas// slob ma la 'di bsgo/ thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// 'gro gsum 'di yang dag pa yin// de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni// khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed na// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces pas so// gnyis pa rjes gnang la mar sbrang bgos pa'i gser gyi thur mas mig 'byed pa'i tshul/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis sel// sems rig stong du ngo sprad/ me long bstan/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni bla med byos// 'on kyang rnal 'byor ma rigs skye// yul snang stong du ngo sprad/

ā las skyes pa'i dril bu/ ā/ bzlas pas dkrol du gzhug thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas// kun kyang mnyam pa nyid du gsal// sgra grags stong du ngo sprad/ rig lnga rim pa bzhin du/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten dag ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// 'khor lo gtad/ 'don pa cung zad bsgyur te rdo rje'i 'khor lo sogs kyi/ rdo rje rin chen padma ral gri gtad rigs lnga'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas/ oṃ badzra he tu maṃ gyis 'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du bzhag oṃ badzra bha ṣa raṃ gyis dung lag g.yas su sbyin/ dril bu dang po ti g.yon du gtad nas klog tu gzhug deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// brtsams te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar bgyi// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin gyur ba// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang*// lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par gsung*// sems can kun la rjes brtse bas// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// nan tan bskyed de bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor// mchod rdzas gtad de/ dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba re re bzung bar bya// gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lo bcas// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// sha dang chang sogs gang ci'ang rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// thams cad gnyis med bar na gnas// he ru ka dpal rtag mchod do// dgang gzar blugs gtad/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*// bsad dang bskrad pa de dag ste// 'phrin las thams cad sgrub par bgyi// ral gri gtad/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lham de bzhin ril bu dang*// mi snang ba dang bcud kyi len// de dag ci dgar sgrub par gyis//

rjes su gnang ba thams cad sgrub par khas len pa/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum bya'o// gsum ba lung bstan/ slob dpon shākya thub par bsam chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar g.yon gyis bzung*/ g.yas pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ khrag 'thung rdo rje de bzhin gshegs// ngas 'dir khyod la lung bstan bya// srid pa ngan 'gro las 'thon te// srid pa shin tu dag phyir ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhya sa ma ya st+waṃ bhur bhu baḥswaḥkye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes pas mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma kun gyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par mdzad de dad par bya'o// bzhi ba dbugs dbyung*/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// mthong ba dang ni zhugs pa yis// sdig pa kun las nges grol bas// khyed rnams de ring legs par gnas// deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// zhes dga' ba brjod par bya'o// de rnams kyis phyi'i rdul tshon nam ras bris sam tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ tshogs la rgyud bshad pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// de nas gsang dbang gi don du shes rab ma bla ma la phul te/ gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇḍal/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs= skyob pa med pa rnams kyi skyabs// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi// ltos med thugs rje chen po yis// bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig /kye ho mgon gtso khyed rnams kyis// theg chen ting 'dzin ji lta bar// 'khor ba'i 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bdag bying 'di las bdag la skyobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐

gis gdong bcings/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo he ru ka yab yum chags pa chen pos snyoms par zhugs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang padma nas sbyin par gyur/ hrīḥji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// rdo rje 'dzin sogs dbang bskur ltar// byang chub sems ni mdzes pa yis// de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro// slob mas kyang sangs rgyas rnams zhu ba'i rdzas su rig nas/ a ho su kha zhes btung bar bya'o// dngos su bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas phan yon brjod pa ni/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dbang bskur cho ga mchog gyur pa// gsung gi rdo rje rnam dag pas// sngags rnams thams cad 'grub par gyur// gdong dkrol/ des rdo rje slob dpon lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam rtsa rlung bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs ba'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// de nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ manḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchog sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu skyob pa'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ces gsol gdab/ mig dar bcings/ slob ma gtso bor bskyed pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ind+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga mnan pa g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral ba'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/

'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdub bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngams pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdengs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ rig ma rdo rje phag mor gsal bar gyur/ phyag rgya rdo rje phag mo de'i lag pa nas bla mas bzung ste/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che// bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma// blangs nas bu yis dus kun tu// bla na med pa'i mchod par gyis// zhes gtad phyag rgya des/ dpa' bo bu khyod ci la spro// byang chub sems ni bza' ba dang*// rigs lnga las ni rab tu byung*// rig ma gus pas yang dag mchod// bshang gci stobs dang dri chen sogs// de ni so sor bza' ba dang*// gzhan yang mdzes pa'i dam tshig rnams// ji ltar spro ba bu yi smros// zhes dri ba la ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// dam tshig thams cad bskyangs pa'i phyir// padma rtag tu cis mi mchod// de nas de'i rang gi bha ga rgyas pa lag pas phye ste/ e ma nga yi padma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na// bdag ni de yi mdun gnas te// bde ba'i cho ga thams cad ni// ji ltar bya ba padmas bgyi// zhes brjod cing de'i nang gi rtsa sor mos bskul te/

mkha' hrīḥlas padma dang ze'u 'bru ās mtshan pa/ rtags hūm̐ las rdo rje dang nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ daṃ dang bye yis thig le rgyu ba'i bu ga bkag ste snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rim pa gnyis mngon du bya'o// mig dar dkrol/ des phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gsum pa thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇḍal phul/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// ces gsol pa gdab/ gsum pa'i dus skyes pa ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas// sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi las// rnam kun cho ga'i sdom pa'o// sdom pa byang chub bde mchog ste// ltar med brjod du med pa'o// zhes tshig gis brda sprad pa bzhi pa'o// des rang sems byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no// dam tshig 'bogs pa/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya// rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya// ma byin pa yang khyod kyis long*// gzhan gyi bud med bsten par bgyi// bcu gcig pa yon 'bul ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal mkha' 'gro dra ba sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐ sogs deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes glang po che dang rta dang rin po che dang sa le sbram dang dngul dang gos dang rgyan dang ba glang dang ma he dang bran pho dang bran mo dang las byed la sogs pa dang sdug pa'i chung ma dang bu dang bu mo la sogs pa rnams kyang ci ltar nus pas bla ma la bkur bsti bya'o// dbang bskur ba 'di yang dkyil 'khor bri ma nus na yid kyis cho ga ji lta ba bsgom pa mngon par rtogs pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i ras bris sogs su yang rung ngo*// bdag bskyed ni/
