lag g.yon du tshom bu bkod nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du padma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba la oṃ baṃ dmar mo/ 'dab ma la g.yon bskor gyis haṃ yauṃ sngon mo/ hriṃ mauṃ dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang khu/ phaṭ phaṭ dud kha/ dpa' mo drug gi rang bzhin mthe bong la/ oṃ haḥdakar po/ mdzub mo la na ma hi ser po/ gung mo la swā hā huṃ dmar po/ srin lag la boṣṭa he nag po/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥmathing kha/ sen mo'i ngos la phaṭ haṃ ljang khu/ dpa' bo drug gi rang bzhin/ lag pa'i bol la 'di dag nyid kyi gzugs brnyan/ lag pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha' rnams rim pa bzhin ltung byed/ gsod byed 'gugs byed gar gyi dbang phyug padma dra ba can ma rnams kyi rang bzhin no// oṃ haḥn ma/ na ma ha na ma/ swā hā ham̐'u na ma/ bau ṣṭa he na ma/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho na ma/ phaṭ haṃ na ma/ oṃ baṃ na ma/ haṃ yauṃ na ma/ hriṃ mauṃ na ma/ hriṃ hriṃ na ma/ huṃ hūm̐ na ma/ phaṭ phaṭ na ma/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā ha ham̐'u/ bau ṣṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭ ha/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yauṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā/ dkyil 'khor rten brten par bcas pa lag pa'i 'khor lo la zhugs/

gnas gsum du srin lag gis bdud rtsi byugs/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas 'khor lo de yang bdag nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum la thim par gyur/ de nas tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang sogs zhes tshad med bzhi bsgoms te sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal he ru ka'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o snyam pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dha rmaḥswa bhā wa shu ddho3haṃ/ phyi rol gyi don med pa thams cad sems tsam/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ sems de yang gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa ye shes kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gag pa med pa nā da tsam/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ paṃ hūm̐ baṃ brtsegs pa rim pa bzhin zhu ba las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du ri rab dang*/ sna tshogs padma lhun po'i kha khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor du sna tshogs rdo rje rwa ba bcu gnyis pa de'i lte bar padma'i sdong po gyen du 'phags pa 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ ge sar dmar ser/ lte ba mthing kha/ gri gug gi 'phreng bas mu khyud byas pa/ gnyis pa la rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor shin tu rnal 'byor chen po bzhi las dang po ni/ a ā nas aṃ aḥ bar tshan gnyis g.yon/ ka kha ga gha nga nas ḍa ḍha/ gnyis pa g.yas/ ā li dang kā li yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i zla ba dkar po dang dmar po/ gnyis pa ni/ kha sbyor gyi dbus su sngar gyi nā da zhugs/ de las thig le/ de las mgo bo/ de las khog pa/ de las zhabs kyu ste hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo 'od zer lnga 'phro ba de las 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs spros/

sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams snyoms par 'jug pas zhu ba rnams dang lhan cig hūm̐ gi nā da la zhugs pa mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin zla ba kha sbyor hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba padma nang ma'i zhes pa nas yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/ zhes pa'i bar gzhung bzhin brjod/ snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgom pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang lha dang bcas pa pheṃ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya/ mig g.yon pa'i steng gi dpral ba'i thad kar bskor mig gyen du ldog rkang pa g.yas brkyang bas g.yon pa'i bol gong mnan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas khrag 'thung chen po rigs lnga'i bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i ka pā las spyi bo nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis ye shes kyi dri ma dag bum gsang shes rab bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ sku bzhi'i he ru ka rdzogs pa nyid kyi spyi bor mi bskyod pa/ phyogs ma bzhi la rin 'byung*/ sgo ma bzhi la snang mtha'/ mtshams ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig gis bskul ba'i 'dod pa'i snam bu la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*// mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor kun= yid 'ong dud kha'i rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha'= dhū pe= dkyil 'khor= kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu=

mar me gang ba'i= nam mkha'= ā lo ke= dkyil 'khor= gdung sel ljang khu rdo rje= dri chab byug pa'i rin= nam mkha'= gandhe= dkyil 'khor= zhal zas ser mo rdo rje dril bu= bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin chen= nam mkha'= nai widya= dkyil 'khor= sgra snyan sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang*// pi wang gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma// nam mkha'= ghaṇḍa ratna huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul// gzugs mdzes dkar mo me long padma'i snod// cang te'u sgra 'khrol kha ṭwāṃ la brten pa/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadzra ā darsha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyal ba kun gyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul// sgra snyan sngon mo pi waṃ padma'i snod// cang te'u= wi ṇi= rgyal ba= dri ldan ser mo spos khang padma'i snod// cang te'u= gandhe= rgyal ba= ro ldan dmar mo bza' btung padma'i snod/ cang te'u= rasye= rgyal= reg ldan ljang khu ras bzang padma'i snod// cang te'u= sparsham huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas bdud rtsi/ mdun du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ā las padma'i snod dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba thod pa gsum gyi sgyed pu la gnas pa'i nang du/ oṃ āṃ trāṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga rlung gis bskul bas me 'bar thod pa bsros pas rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char ka'i kha dog can/ de'i steng du dngul chu'i mdog can gyi hūm̐ las byung ba'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po thur du blta ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bas ro gcig par gyur pa rnams a ā= nas/ ḍa ḍha/ ā li g.yon bskor/ kā li g.yas bskor du song ba'i yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge brtsegs mar gnas pa de dag las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas 'od du zhu nas yi ge gsum la rim pa bzhin thim/

aṃ yig zhu bas sbyangs ā yig gis mang por spel/ hūm̐ yig gis sbar ba dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas oṃ ā hūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas/ lha mo rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa rdo rje dkar po 'od kyi sbu gu can gyis gsol bar gyur/ de nas sgra snyan lta bu'i lha tshogs kyis bstod pa byed pas bltas te/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor// khyod ni rang gi thugs kyi yongs su mnyes ldan pa// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun sbyangs shing*// sems can rnams la thugs rje'i mthu stobs mdzad pa'o// sgyu ma'i spros pa rnams la rdo rje 'bebs mdzad cing*// e ma ho mnyes ldan thugs kyi rdo rje he ru ka dpal bstod// de ltar ma sun gyi bar du bsgom la de nas/ bdag gi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa bu ga yi ge daṃ gyis bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' ā las padma 'dab brgyad bye yis bkag pa/ snyoms par zhugs pas rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis bskul ba'i byang chub kyi sems padma'i sna rtser lhung ba chos 'byung gi nang der rten gzhal yasakhang*/ brten pa lha'i dkyil 'khor/ bsgom pas rlung sems dbu mar gzhug par gyur/ 'di ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o// de las 'phro na/ ngag gis bzlas par bya ste/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba bdag gi rdo rje'i sgo nas lha mo'i padma'i sgo dang*/ lha mo'i kha'i sgo nas bdag gi kha'i sgor 'jug pa yin no// oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzwa la swaṃ raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇā nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab yum snying po nye snying ngo*/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye= oṃ lā me= oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi= oṃ rū pi ṇi=

oṃ ka kā sye= oṃ ullu ka sye= oṃ shwa na kā sye= oṃ sū ka rā sye= oṃ ya ma da= oṃ ya ma dhu= oṃ ya mdaṃ= oṃ ya ma ma thā ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lha mo rnams kyi sngags so// rkang pa brgyad pa/ oṃ na mo bhag ba te bī re shā ya/ mahā kalpāgni sannibhāya/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭotkaṭāya/ daṃṣṭā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya// sa ha bhudza bhāsu rā ya/ par shu pā shodyata shū la khaṭwāṃg dhāri ni/ byāghā dzi nā mbar dharā ya/ mahā dhūmrāndhakār wa pu ṣā ya/ rkang pa nyer bzhi pa/ kar kar/ ku ru ku ru/ bandha bandha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ kṣo bha ya kṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ/ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭ/ phaṭ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhakṣa bhakṣa/ ba sa rudhirānt+ra mā lā ba lambine/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ sapta pā tā la bhudzaṃ gāṃ sarpaṃ wā/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaḍḍha ā kaḍḍha/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ kṣ+māṃ kṣ+māṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ/ rtsa sngags 'phreng ba'i sngags kyang bya'o// oṃ haḥn ma hi/ swā hā ham̐'u/ bau ṣṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭ haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yauṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ bar lan gsum/ go cha'i sngags so// yi ge brgya bas lhag chad bskang*/ dbang rab gnas sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor sgrub mchod lta bu'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bdag nyid las gnyis su phye nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la sngar bzhin du bzhugs par bsam la/ dbang bskur rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs bya'o// ma 'dus na bdag bskyed bzhin gtor ma btang bdag bskyed bsdu'o// thun mtshams gtor ma ni/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro hi= oṃ swa bhā wa nas stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ā las padma'i snod dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba thod pa gsum gyi sgyed bu la gnas pa'i nang du/

oṃ āṃ trāṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga rlung gis bskul bas me 'bar thod pa bsros pa'i rdzas rnams zhu ba nyi ma 'char ka'i kha dog can/ de'i steng dngul chu'i kha dog can gyi hūm̐ las byung ba'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po thur du blta ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bas ro gcig par gyur pa rnams a ā i ī nas aṃ ā ka kha ga gha nas ḍa ḍha ā li g.yon bskor kā li g.yas bskor du song ba yongs su gyur pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge brtsegs mar gnas pa de dag las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams 'phros 'gro ba'i don byas snyoms par 'jug pa sngon du 'gro bas 'od du zhu nas yi ge gsum la rim pa bzhin thim/ oṃ yig zhu bas sbyangs/ āḥyig gis mang por spel/ hūm̐ yig gis sbar ba dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma bza' ba bca' ba chang la sogs pa'i btung ba ji tsam rnyed pa byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang stang stabs bcas/ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ gu ru shrī badzra he ru kaḥ.akaḍḍha ya akaḍḍha ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ bandha ya bandha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba badzra ḍā ki ni hri da ya/ a ba to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ āṃḥhūm̐/ sarba wi ra yo gi nī swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de la / oṃ āḥbadzra arghaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de bzhin du/ oṃ= pādyaṃ= añtsa mā nī= puṣpe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= ghandhe= nai widye= shapta hūm̐= oṃ= ā darsha= wi ni= ghandhe= rasye= oṃ= sparshe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a āḥ.i īḥ sogs zhes pa nas aṃ āḥlag pa g.yon ā li las zla ba/ ka kha ga gha nga sogs nas ḍa ḍha/ lag pa g.yas kā li las nyi ma kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ

sarba dharm+māpa ra spa ra a nu pra biṣṭaḥ sarba dharm+mā a tantu a nu pra biṣṭaḥsarba dharmāḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐ de dag yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i thal mo/ de'i steng du gtor ma bzhag nas bzhes pa'i don du/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// de gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ de nas lag pa pad bskor byas te/ sa ma yast+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ mchod bya mchod byed/ mchod pa thams cad tha mi dad par gyur/ oṃ a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ driṣya hoḥ gtso bo nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar la phyogs g.yon/ mtshams g.yas bskor gyis 'bul zhing*/ ye shes kyi mgron gzhan thams cad la/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis stob bo/ de nas/ lha rnams kyi ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes par gyur/ sngar bzhin oṃ āḥbadzra arghaṃ nas shapta 'i bar dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i sngags bcas kyi mchod do// bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug sogs dang dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ji snyed ma sogs kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag lta ba bcom// khyod ni dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi brjid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod pa 'dis dngos grub blangs phyag rgya sngar bzhin gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa/ rā kṣas/ bhūta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ utmā da/ a pa smā ra/ badzra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhnantu/ sa ma ya rakṣan tu/ ma ma sarba siddhi me pra yatstshantu/

ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ khā da tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gha tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka ra ta ya/ sat+su khaṃ/ bi shuddhaye sa hā yi ka bha wan tu huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// sogs gong bzhin brjod ces 'dod pa'i dngos grub blangs/ brda'i lag pas brda bstan te/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes bya ba brjod cing padma skor pa'i phyag rgyas mnyes par byas te nye bar bsdu ba'i phyag rgya mi phyed par 'khyud pa sngon du 'gro bas mthe bong dang srin lag se gol brdab par bya ste/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badzra muḥ/ gtor mgron ye shes pa rnams bdag nyid la thim// 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur// de nas chos skyong gi gtor bsngo bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar byas nas/ de nas tshogs la las chu bdud rtsi gnyis kyis bsangs gtor byas la/ oṃ khanḍa ro hi= oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ tshogs rnams mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor

nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum bar/ tshogs phud drug tu bcad/ tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba la thugs gtad par zhu/ zhes las kyi rdo rjes gsol phud stegs shing*/ mchod do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rtsa brgyud kyi rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ gnyis pa/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzwa la samba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ sarba bhuddha ḍā ki ni ye badzra warṇa nīye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra= oṃ ḍā ki ni ye= oṃ lā me= oṃ khanḍa ro hi= oṃ rū pi ni ye= ga ṇa= oṃ kā kā sye= oṃ ū lu kā sye= oṃ shwa nā kā sye= oṃ sū ka rā sye= ga ṇa= oṃ ya ma da dhi= oṃ ya ma dū ti= oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣṭi nī ye= oṃ ya ma ma thā ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ gsum pa/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza= bzhi pa/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū= lnga pa/ dpal ma hā ka la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum gyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen mo bya rog ming can 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam pa'i chos skyong ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du ga ṇa= drug pa/

gzhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid la gnas pa sogs lha ma srin sde brgyad/ 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes phyag sngon du 'gro ba/ skyes pa'i thod pa bzang por myos byed rnam pa brgyad po gang rung gis bkang ste padma bskor bas/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom bya mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa dang*// rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs nas gsol// zhes slob dpon la stob des padma bskor ba'i mthar/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma med pa 'di// gzung 'dzin rnam par grol ba yi// de bzhin nyid ni bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod pas blangs te btung*/ de nas bza' ba sogs longs spyod/ mo gtso bo yin na sha thog mar rol/ de nas phyag rgya dang thun mong du spyod de rgyu 'di las ni tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'gyur la/ gzhan yid kyis rol pa tsam ni ston mo zhes brjod kyis/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i ming mi thob bo// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi kha chang gis bkang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas hūm̐ zhes drag pos kha khru btab la/ oṃ āḥbadzra paṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ nas/ nai widye oṃ sarba kha kha khā hi khā hi u tstshiṣṭa ba lingta u tstshiṣṭa bhakṣe bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes 'byung po chol ba rnams la sbyin/ sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyis ni 'gro ba'i yid kyi 'dod pa mchog ni kun rdzogs mdzad/ he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer thams cad phye mar brlag gang zhig 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhing bla ma rgyal ba'i ye shes 'byung gnas mthar phyin mdzad// de ni snying rje chen pos dbang gyur 'phags pa rnams kyi rtag tu myur bar bkra shis yin// sogs kyis bkra shis kyi glu blang ngo*// de nas dge ba bsngo ba/

he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo mchod pa yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos shing*// rlabs chen spyod pa rdzogs pa dang*// he ru ka dang mnyam pa yi// go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par shog /'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum bsags pa yi// yod pa'i dge ba ma lus gcig bsdus nas// bde chen byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// sku gsum rgyal srid chen po thob par shog /oṃ āḥbadzra arghaṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥbadzra a darsha sogs kyi 'dod yon lngas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan mgon po dbang phyug chen po sogs dpal ldan rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ de nas yi ge brgya pa brjod/ sgrub mchod kyi tshe yang dkyil 'khor bsgrub kha tshun ji lta ba bzhugs/ bsgrub khar yid kyi rdul mtshon nyid du bsgyur/ de min gzhan don gyi las la/ ma 'byor ba dang= dge ba 'di yis= ces sogs smon lam btab/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags dang lhan cig pad skor byas pa'i mnyes par byas te/ phyag rgya nye bar bsdus la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgyas se gol brdab pa dang lhan cig sa la reg oṃ badzra muḥ zhes brjod nas gshegs su gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi re kha phyag par bya'o// ras bris sogs yin na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis dam tshig pa bstims shing ye shes par rang gi snying gar bsdu'o// ma 'byor ba dang= sogs kyis bzod gsol bya/ snod bcud kyi dngos po rnams gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa la thim/ de yum la/ yab yum rjes chags kyi bde ba chen por zhu ba gsang ba'i sna rtser dkar dmar gyi thig le kha sbyar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bde ba'i rang bzhin la rnam par shes pa'i bya ba bral ba 'od gsal ba mngon du gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag go de la mi gnas par 'phro grabs byed na/

thig le dkar po las bcom ldan 'das/ dmar po las bcom ldan 'das mar langs te rim gyis 'od zer 'phreng bar thug pa'i bar du snang la zhen 'dzin gyis slad pa med par blta'o// yang sngar bzhin thig le la 'jug pa yang nas yang du bya zhing*/ gsum pa ni gal te thun las ldang na/ thig le las he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ste/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'khor lo sdom pa 'grub gyur nas/ 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /padma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan// sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi bcu gnyis phyag /phag mo'i mgul 'khyud dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor// bde mchog lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis shog/ ces shis pa brjod de bya ba gzhan la 'jug go /de ltar rdo rje btsun mos mdzad pa'i sdom pa lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa nā ro'i zhabs thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal rgyun ji lta bar rgyas par byas pa 'di yang gzhis ka gri gu pa sde pa chos rje blo gros pad dkar gyis rgyu'i dus kyi bskul/ byar po rtogs ldan dpal 'byor dar rgyas de dus kyis bskul ba po byas te padma dkar pos lhas bstan gyi ri bo gsang sngags chos gling gi chos grwar sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro ba thams cad dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /
